spiritual_reading.full_translation:
No finite mind can recount the inner being of the contrary principle, nor unveil the mode of its enduring, for it stands outside the order that makes spiritual life intelligible. Yet its universal powers and the universal dominations within it disclose enough to grasp its measure: a perpetuity of opposition, persisting without heavenly order, whose so‑called beginning and end are only the fixed boundaries of what is permitted.

Therefore the state of spiritual death is named as a distinct domain: a reigning quality of inverted life that holds together by conjunctions of evil with falsity, and of falsity with evil, so that it exists in a unity that is itself hostility.

No one can comprehend how such a dual opposition endures from itself, because nothing higher is made manifest within it that could speak from within it about its origin. Yet when it first roused itself into active resistance against wisdom, it desired not only separation but dominion over those who are in living good and truth.

Then the first going‑forth of saving power met it and restrained it, keeping it outside the community of life. From the time when wisdom was permitted to be entangled with falsity, and living good to be bound within what is dead, there arose a regulated measure by which the first recipient powers and those who teach afterward could speak from revelation about the conflict: how contempt and assault came to be, how wisdom was woven into falsity, and how life was held as if imprisoned within death.

After it stirred within its own essential quality, it turned its whole intention back into itself and drew its domain together into one concentrated endeavor, seeking to plunge whatever was of wisdom into the lowest obscurity so that no light would appear. This was sustained by a persuasion within that state that evil is strength and falsity is firmness, so that it seemed unbreakable, as though its prevailing power could not be resisted.

From the willing of spiritual death arose envious delight, which justified wickedness and sharpened the impulse to injure the opposed domain of life.

It then hastened from obscurity toward the outermost limits of life, gathering its operative powers into a single thrust; and the more deeply it pressed toward what is living, the more firmly its persuasions and delights held together within those powers.

It spread itself into a sufficient series of fundamental falsities: obscured understanding, burning self‑love, unstable persuasion, perverted truth, and active denial of good. From these falsities arose organized systems of perverted perception; and within those systems it generated many derivative compulsions and tendencies, unlike one another. In the interior depths of its lowest mind it produced abundant hellish affections and thoughts—destroying impulses, devouring persuasions, brutal cupidities—and it was fixed and strengthened in hideous spiritual forms. Because conjunction there is only by common hatred, their community became mutual slaughter and continual conflict.

Then the deliberation within the ruling love humbled and bent its whole external order and all its subordinate powers toward one aim. It perceived living good and wisdom above itself, and conspired to wage conflict against the exalted kingdom of heaven and against the ordered goods and truths there.

But the Divine Source of love and wisdom also perceived the permitted assault and its aim to disturb the heavenly state. Therefore, from mercy united with wisdom, it provided a mode of presence suited to the lower degree, setting in order a form of resistance by which what rose from below would be met and restrained without violation of what is higher.

At that time there was a commanded going‑forth of Divine operation against the uprising opposition.

The contrary principle poured itself outward into its fundamental falsities, rising from the lowest obscurity and establishing itself within perverted perceptions as fixed bases for opposition.

And when those perverted perceptions were in place, it brought forth works from them, holding its own life as if set within those works; and by these it summoned a sufficient complement of operative powers belonging to the first saving combatant, fitted for action in the outermost degree.

When, through those works, it generated further offspring of evil and falsity, these derivations descended into the natural degree and drew strength from the fundamental falsities, being nourished by them. Thus wickedness together with cruelty was gathered into the ruling love, the leader of all hellish forces. It bent its external orders and powers, drew them into one dominating evil, and made itself ready for conflict against the heavenly state in ultimates and against the Divine Kingship present within it.

At that very moment the first saving power drew near to its invested operative forces—the shining goods and truths fitted for combat. It spoke with them to entrust what must be done, revealing and teaching all that was necessary for action. It took them into itself, arranged and conjoined them into a single form of resistance, disposing external truths upon inner truths and fixing them throughout the whole capacity for use, so that it might meet the impending onrush with all its powers, though the full measure of the closing description cannot be completely unfolded from the fragmentary wording.

paragraph_translations.translation: No finite mind can recount the inner being of the contrary principle, nor unveil the manner of its enduring, for it stands outside the order that makes spiritual life intelligible. Yet the universal forces within it, and the dominations by which it holds itself, disclose its measure as a perpetuity of opposition, persisting without heavenly order. What is called its beginning and its end are only the fixed boundaries of what is permitted.
paragraph_translations.notes: The paragraph is heavily broken; the sense of “limits,” “beginning,” and “end of permission” can be carried, but details of “rulers unveil its measure” are compressed.

paragraph_translations.notes: The phrase “nature of the essence” is difficult; rendered as an enduring governing quality.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strong coherence from ¶2–¶11: an account of the self-confirmation of evil and falsity, their organization into systems and offspring, and their intent to assault heaven, followed by a Divine provision of resistance suited to lower degrees. ¶12 is too fragmentary to add more than a minimal statement. ¶13–¶16 cohere as a sequence of manifestation into fundamental falsities → perverted perceptions → works → further derivations, culminating in the first saving power’s orderly investment of operative truths and goods for combat; the final clause in ¶16 stumbles due to textual corruption but does not break the overall spiritual line.

findings.diagnosis: Clean but heavily damaged opening. The teaching is still correspondential (essence, measure, limits/permission), but lacunae force the reader to compress and smooth the logic.
findings.evidence: Text: “What the essence of [the Darkness]—no person could recount… all [its powers] and [its rulers] unveil [its measure]… the [limits]… the end [of its permission]…” Reading notes: “heavily broken… sense… can be carried, but details… are compressed.” The stumble is not a voice shift but missing grammar and missing predicates; nevertheless the thematic line (unknowability → measure via powers/rulers → limits of permission) remains intelligible.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent substrate sequence establishing the two-nature opposition and the epistemic claim that only after mixture can it be taught. Difficulty is lexical (“nature of the essence,” “first-born and apostles”) but the narrative logic is continuous and functional (how knowledge becomes possible).
findings.evidence: Text: ¶3 “land of death… nature of the essence… an accord in enmity”; ¶4 “no person is able to understand… no other power… manifested… However, from the time when it stirred itself”; ¶5 “First Man… prevented it… From that time, when the light was mixed… there was a measure of approval and an ability… to teach.” Reading notes: “ ‘First-born and apostles’ treated as first recipient powers and later teachers” and “Mid-sentence break… smoothed.” The “First-born/apostles” are not a jurisdictional list; they function here as epistemic agents who can ‘teach about it’ because mixture provides experiential access—this fits correspondential logic.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from corruption, not an insertion. The passage is a functional description of self-contraction/confirming hardness leading to envy and assault. The reader’s struggle comes from broken syntax and duplicated/garbled phrases (adamant hardness, ‘depth essence… no light’).
findings.evidence: Text: ¶6 “For ⟨p.68⟩ [depth] essence in [i]t [was no light] because a [reason] they reckoned… harder than the Adamant [stone]”; ¶7 is fragmentary; ¶8 “his members… is deep [the more firmly it was bound].” Reading notes: “source is very corrupt… translated as a self-confirming persuasion of invincibility” and “Syntax is broken.” Removing any part would not improve narrative flow; the whole unit is already the expected ‘hardening’ stage before outward aggression.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly correspondential, but with a mild administrative-looking taxonomy seam (explicit five-element inventory). Here it does not break the story; it provides the generative mechanism for subsequent ‘trees/fruits/offspring’ imagery and continues the functional account of proliferation. Because the fivefold is integrated into the narrative of generation, it is not a detachable overlay.
findings.evidence: Text: “generated itself [of the five dark elements]; which [are] smoke, fire, wind, water and darkness. [From them] sprouted trees… numerous emanations… destroyers and dragons…” Reading: it interprets the list as “fundamental falsities,” and notes the creature-list as varieties of affections/thoughts. The potential stumble is the sudden enumerated inventory, but it immediately feeds the functional chain (elements → trees → fruits/offspring → creatures/war), so excision would damage coherence.

findings.diagnosis: A voice shift toward administrative framing begins in ¶10–¶12, but it is not a full overlay; it is an embedded governance-style turn (‘counsel,’ ‘ruler,’ ‘commanded… God by order’) inserted into an otherwise functional narrative. This is exactly where the spiritual reading flags a ‘SHIFT’ (¶11) and reduces ¶12 to a minimal placeholder because it cannot derive correspondential meaning from the administrative idiom plus damage.
findings.evidence: Text: ¶10 “counsel of their ruler… conspired to wage a war”; ¶11 “Father of Greatness… transformed himself… set a form”; ¶12 “he commanded his power… God [by order].” Reading notes: ¶11 marked “SHIFTS”; ¶12 “Very fragmentary… preserved as commanded Divine operation.” The governance language (counsel/command/order) is characteristic of administrative voice. Yet ¶11 still contains functional content (“set a form against it”) that can be read correspondentially as accommodation. The main stumble occurs at ¶12 because it is both administrative in phrasing and textually broken, yielding no functional correspondences to unpack.
findings.scope: ¶12: “Indeed, at that time [he commanded his power to] go against [it] God [by order]”

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential combat-preparation narrative with one internal administrative micro-insertion: the identification and summoning of “the five garments, the sons of the First Man” (¶14). This line introduces a named, numbered entity in inventory form that does not participate as agents in the surrounding functional chain (elements → trees → fruits → offspring). The reader has to allegorize it as “a sufficient complement of operative powers,” which is a tell that the text has switched briefly to a systematizing taxonomy at a seam.
findings.evidence: Text: ¶13 “poured it out… in the elements… set in the trees”; ¶14 “they summoned the five garments, the sons of the First Man”; ¶15 continues functional generation and consolidation into “the ruler, the leader of all the demons”; ¶16 resumes functional arming: “First Man approached his garments… He assumed them. He arranged them… draped them… upon his limbs.” Reading notes at ¶14: it must paraphrase the phrase into abstraction (“sufficient complement of operative powers… fitted for action”), indicating the phrase resists the purely functional reading. Narratively, skipping the summoning clause leaves a smooth chain: trees/fruits/offspring strengthen evil → ruler consolidates → First Man approaches/assumes/arranges garments for battle (¶16 supplies the real ‘garments’ action anyway). This redundancy is classic expansion-at-a-seam behavior.
findings.scope: ¶14: “They summoned the five garments, the sons of the Fir[st] Man.”

findings.diagnosis: End-stumble is genuine corruption rather than insertion. The clause appears to describe the extremity/height and immeasurable onset of powers, but the grammar is shredded; the reader explicitly cannot unfold it. Removing it would simply truncate the chapter, not restore a clearer underlying sequence.
findings.evidence: Text: “danger, it [so that, when there was] the heights of the earth [was coming upon] with all its powers [begin]inning, it being immeasurable [without measure]” Reading notes: “ending is badly broken… uncertainty flagged.” The preceding actions (approach → speak → assume → arrange → drape) are coherent; only the final descriptive tail fails.

textual_criticism.summary: 7 findings: 3 clean correspondential stretches confirmed (¶3–¶5; much of ¶9; ¶13–¶16 core), 3 genuine damage-related difficulties (¶2; ¶6–¶8; ¶16 tail), and 2 probable insertions at seams where the spiritual reading had to flatten governance/taxonomy into abstraction. Recommended excisions: 2 micro-units (¶12; the single summoning sentence in ¶14). No full administrative overlay block is present in this excerpt.
